_how_to_fill_this_in: This file records the apps that YOU tested as a beta tester (ASSIGNMENT_09 §4.4). Write one object for each app: the app of each classmate who listed you as a tester and who was in the lecture.
owner is the 9-digit student number of the owner of the app. Do not write your own number.
device names your phone. The app must be installed from the test track of the owner's store.
tcs lists the ids of the test cases of the owner that you ran: at least three, at least one of them outside the login. free_use is true if you also used the app freely.
problems is the number of problems that you saw. note says the most important one in one full sentence, or "no problem".
nobody_listed_me: set it to true only if no classmate listed you as a tester; then the list 'tested' may stay empty.
The owner writes the same test in their own week09/beta_runs.json. The instructor compares the two files.
Type this file yourself, by hand, right after the turn. No assistant writes, translates or corrects it, not even for the grammar. Your English or Turkish is not graded. A person reads it.
Add as many objects as you need, with a comma between them. You may delete this block after you read it. The checker ignores it.
